integrity: The proof is analytic: Haar pushforward gives exactly three samples, convexity forces balanced coefficient magnitudes, and a divided-difference argument proves the phase monotonicity for every real \(p>2\). Finite computations are used only as corroborative regression checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only two characters whose relative character has order exactly 3.
No classification is claimed for other finite orders or for more than two frequencies.
An older equivalent formulation may exist in finite-dimensional Lp geometry under terminology not retrieved by the searches.
title: A sharp phase transition for an order-three character pair
